Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect to switch the target of attack to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait.
Notes: Championship 25-26 Finals Season 1 Digimon Tamers Pack
